Miami Website Maintenance

Website Maintenance Services in Miami, FL

Website maintenance is the ongoing work of keeping a business website updated, secure, fast, backed up, and visible in Google and AI search. For Miami businesses, from Brickell professional firms to Kendall dental practices and Doral trade companies, it is the difference between a site that quietly generates calls and one that fails the week a plugin update goes wrong. FixWebsiteIssues.com, the website repair and technical SEO division of WevTEC, has provided it since 2013 with monthly plans from $300 and 24/7 emergency repair. We maintain WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, and custom sites for Miami-Dade businesses remotely from our Houston office, with the same team that repairs hacked and broken sites every week.

Plans From $300/Month | 24/7 Emergency Repair | WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Custom | Houston-Based, Serving Miami Remotely Since 2013

What Is Website Maintenance?

Website maintenance is the scheduled, ongoing work of keeping a website’s software current, its security intact, its pages fast and error-free, its data backed up, and its visibility in Google and AI search protected. Hosting keeps a site online; maintenance keeps it working, safe, and found. For a Miami business that is a monthly cycle of updates, security scans, speed checks, backups, and monitoring, with fast repair when something breaks between cycles.

Most failures we repair for Miami and Florida clients were preventable: a plugin unpatched for a year until a known vulnerability was exploited, a PHP version the host retired, a contact form that stopped delivering leads for months, a WooCommerce checkout that broke after a theme update nobody tested. Maintenance exists so those are caught on a schedule rather than discovered by a customer, or by a hurricane-season traffic spike the site cannot handle.

Why it matters more now

Google’s guidance for Search and its AI features rewards sites that are crawlable, fast, secure, and current. AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot retrieve live pages; a slow, blocked, or error-filled site is skipped. Maintenance keeps a business eligible to be found, which is why every plan includes technical SEO checks and why the Advanced and Premium plans add the visibility work described on our Miami SEO services page.

Every Miami plan includes

  • CMS, plugin, theme, and PHP updates, tested
  • Security monitoring and malware prevention
  • Scheduled off-site backups with restore
  • Uptime, error, and form monitoring
  • Speed and Core Web Vitals checks
  • Technical SEO health checks
  • A phone number that gets answered, 24/7 for emergencies

Who Website Maintenance in Miami Is For

Any business whose website brings in calls, bookings, quotes, or orders. The Miami businesses that get the most from a plan fall into a few groups.

Small and family-owned businesses without an IT person. The owner is the webmaster by default, updates get skipped, and the first sign of trouble is a customer saying the site is down.

Service companies that live on lead forms: cleaning, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, pest control across Kendall, Doral, Hialeah, and west Miami-Dade. A form that fails for a week is a week of lost jobs.

Medical, dental, and aesthetic practices in Coral Gables, Brickell, Aventura, and South Miami, where downtime, data exposure, or a broken booking widget has compliance and revenue consequences.

Restaurants, hospitality, and retail on Miami Beach and in Coconut Grove with reservation, ordering, and ecommerce integrations that break silently.

Law firms, real estate, and professional services whose sites carry reputations and cannot show a security warning to a prospective client.

Signs your website needs maintenance now

  • Sudden drop in Google traffic, calls, or form submissions
  • Pages load slowly or throw server errors
  • Browser shows “not secure” or a security warning
  • Search Console emails about errors or a manual action
  • WordPress shows a stack of pending updates
  • Host suspended the account or flagged malware
  • The site looks different on a phone than it did last month

When something else comes first

If the site is hacked, redirecting, or down, start with Miami hacked website repair or WordPress error repair; maintenance begins once the site is stable.

Problems Website Maintenance Solves for Miami Businesses

The six failures we repair most often for Florida clients without a plan. Each is caught on the monthly cycle once they have one.

Problem

The site gets hacked

Outdated plugins are the usual entry point; the result is spam pages, redirects, and a Google warning. Fix: monthly updates, malware scanning, firewall rules, login hardening, and a clean backup to restore from.

Problem

Lead forms stop sending

A deliverability change or plugin update breaks the form and nobody notices for weeks. Fix: monthly form tests, SMTP with logging, alerts when a submission fails.

Problem

An update breaks layout or checkout

A theme or WooCommerce update takes the homepage or cart apart. Fix: updates run on staging first, visual check before and after, instant rollback.

Problem

The site is slow and rankings slide

Unoptimized images, bloated plugins, no caching. Fix: caching, image compression, database cleanup, Core Web Vitals tracked monthly.

Problem

No usable backup when it matters

The host backup is missing, corrupted, or overwritten by the hacked version. Fix: off-site backups on a schedule, retained for weeks, restore tested.

Problem

Google and AI search quietly lose the site

A stray noindex, expired SSL, redirect chain, or blocked crawler drops pages from Google and AI answers. Fix: Search Console review, crawler access checks, schema and Business Profile consistency monthly.

Miami Website Maintenance Plans and Monthly Pricing

Three plans, month to month, priced by what your site needs rather than by page count. Every plan includes the maintenance cycle; higher plans add visibility and marketing work.

Basic

Basic Website Maintenance

$300 / month

For small businesses that need a stable, secure, updated site.

  • Scheduled off-site backups
  • CMS, plugin, theme, and PHP updates
  • Security monitoring and malware prevention
  • Error and uptime monitoring, minor fixes
  • Monthly form and speed checks
  • Technical SEO health check
Start Basic
Advanced · Most Popular

Advanced Maintenance + Visibility

$500–$1,000 / month

For growing Miami businesses that want the site maintained and found.

  • Everything in Basic
  • Google Business Profile maintenance
  • On-page and technical SEO fixes each month
  • Local SEO for Miami-Dade neighborhoods
  • AI search readiness: crawler access, schema, entity consistency
  • One social channel supported
  • Monthly performance and security report
Start Advanced
Premium

Premium Maintenance + Digital Marketing

$1,500–$2,000 / month

For businesses that want the website fully managed and actively growing.

  • Everything in Advanced
  • Ongoing SEO strategy and content support
  • Google Ads management
  • Social media management
  • Conversion tracking and call/form attribution
  • AI visibility monitoring across ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot
  • Quarterly strategy review
Start Premium

Pricing scales with site complexity (ecommerce, multi-location, custom code). Emergency repair for non-plan clients is quoted per job. Spanish-language site maintenance is included at no extra cost when the site already has Spanish pages.

Website Maintenance by Industry in Miami

Every industry breaks in its own way. These are the priorities we set for the Miami business types we maintain most.

Industry

Small Business

Restaurants, salons, boutiques, studios, accountants, and insurance agents on 5-to-15-page WordPress sites. Priorities: updates and backups, a working contact form and click-to-call, hours and address matching Google Business Profile, SSL, and mobile speed. Basic plan fits most.

Industry

Medical, Dental & Aesthetic

Practices in Coral Gables, Brickell, Aventura, and South Miami with booking widgets, patient forms, and provider pages. Priorities: privacy-conscious form handling, booking integrations tested with a real submission, provider pages accurate, LocalBusiness and Physician schema on the practice site maintained.

Industry

Home Services & Trades

Cleaning, remodeling, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, and construction across west and south Miami-Dade. Priorities: quote and estimate forms tested monthly, service-area pages current, storm-season traffic capacity, gallery plugins healthy, and security hardening against spam injection.

Industry

Restaurants & Hospitality

Miami Beach, Wynwood, Coconut Grove, and Brickell venues with reservation, ordering, and menu integrations. Priorities: third-party scripts tested after every update, menu and hours accuracy synced to Google, image-heavy pages kept fast.

Industry

Ecommerce

WooCommerce and Shopify stores. Priorities: payment gateway and checkout tested with a live order monthly, plugin compatibility on staging, product schema valid, backups retained through sales periods, and speed on product pages.

Industry

Law, Real Estate & Professional Services

Firms whose site is the reputation. Priorities: zero security warnings, attorney and agent pages accurate, IDX and CRM integrations tested, and document downloads working.

The Monthly Website Maintenance Checklist We Run

Every Miami maintenance client gets this ten-point cycle each month, logged and reported. Items 1 through 6 are in every plan; 7 through 10 are where Advanced and Premium go deeper.

Get a Free Site Health Check
  1. Backup and verify. Full off-site backup before any change; restore tested at least quarterly.
  2. Update and test. Core, plugins, themes, PHP updated on staging, then live, with a visual and functional check.
  3. Security sweep. Malware scan, file integrity, firewall, admin accounts, SSL expiry, login attempts.
  4. Uptime and error review. Logs, 404s, PHP errors, and server warnings from the past month.
  5. Forms and conversions. Every lead form, booking widget, and click-to-call tested with a real submission.
  6. Speed and Core Web Vitals. Field data reviewed; images, caching, scripts tuned.
  7. Search Console review. Index coverage, crawl errors, manual actions, performance trends for Miami queries.
  8. Google Business Profile sync. Hours, categories, services, photos consistent with the site.
  9. Schema and entity check. Structured data validated and matched to visible content; AI crawler access confirmed.
  10. Report and recommend. A plain-English monthly summary of what was done, found, and what comes next.

How Website Maintenance Works With FixWebsiteIssues

1. Free site health check

A call or form, then we look at the site: errors, security state, speed, index coverage, and whether the forms work. You get findings before you pay anything.

2. Stabilize first

If the check finds a hack, a broken update, or a hosting problem, that is repaired first as a one-time job. Maintenance starts on a stable site.

3. Onboard and document

Secure access is set up, a full backup taken, and the site documented: plugins, integrations, hosting, DNS, admin users. Sites built by other Miami agencies are welcome.

4. Run the monthly cycle

The ten-point checklist, every month, staging-first, with a written log.

5. Handle emergencies

Plan clients call the same number 24/7. Most errors are fixed the same day; hacks are contained within hours.

6. Report and improve

A monthly summary in plain English, plus the SEO, Business Profile, and AI visibility work that Advanced and Premium plans include.

How We Approach Maintenance

We are a repair company first. Since 2013 most of our clients found us after something broke, which is why our prevention checklist covers the things that actually fail: the plugins that get exploited, the hosts that retire PHP versions without warning, the “minor” updates that take down a checkout.

Updates are tested, not clicked. Bulk-updating a live site is how layouts break. We update on a staging copy, check the pages that matter, push live, and keep the backup ready.

Forms are checked with real submissions. A green checkmark in a dashboard means nothing if the email never arrives.

Visibility is part of maintenance. A site that works but has fallen out of Google or AI answers is not being maintained. Search Console, Business Profile, schema, and crawler access are on the checklist; deeper work is handled by our Miami SEO and AI Search Optimization teams.

Maintenance vs Hosting vs One-Time Repair

Miami business owners often assume hosting covers maintenance. It does not.

AreaWeb hostingOne-time repairMonthly maintenance
What it doesKeeps the server onlineFixes a specific problem after it happensPrevents problems; keeps the site current, secure, fast, and visible
UpdatesServer software onlyWhatever the fix needsCMS, plugins, themes, PHP, tested monthly
SecurityNetwork level; the site is your responsibilityCleanup after a hackScans, firewall, hardening, monitoring before a hack
BackupsOften present, rarely testedUses whatever existsScheduled, off-site, retained, restore-tested
SEO and AI visibilityNoneOnly if the problem was SEO-relatedSearch Console, Business Profile, schema, crawler checks monthly
Typical cost$10 to $100+ per monthQuoted per job$300 to $2,000 per month by plan

Website Maintenance Across Miami-Dade

All work is remote with secure, controlled access, so response time is the same in Brickell or Homestead. These are the areas where most of our Florida maintenance clients are based.

Brickell and Downtown Miami

Law firms, financial and professional services, concierge medical, and aesthetic clinics on multi-user WordPress and custom sites with more integrations than most. Maintenance leans on staging-first updates, access audits, and uptime monitoring.

Coral Gables and South Miami

Medical, dental, legal, and real estate practices running polished sites that were built once and left alone. Our work is usually bringing an older, well-designed site up to current PHP, security, and Core Web Vitals standards without changing how it looks.

Doral and Hialeah

Trade companies, logistics, home services, automotive, and small businesses, many with bilingual sites. We keep Spanish and English pages in sync, test quote forms monthly, and harden sites that are frequent spam-injection targets.

Kendall and West Kendall

Family dental and medical practices, home services, and consumer businesses where the owner is the only admin. We take updates, backups, and security off their plate and keep the Business Profile matching the site.

Miami Beach and Coconut Grove

Restaurants, hospitality, wellness, and retail with reservation, ordering, and ecommerce integrations. Third-party scripts are tested after every update; image-heavy pages are kept fast for visitors on hotel Wi-Fi.

Aventura and North Miami-Dade

Retail, medical and dental practices, and aesthetics with review-conscious customers. Priorities are zero security warnings, booking integrations tested, and hours accuracy across the site and Google.

Also serving Homestead, Cutler Bay, Palmetto Bay, Pinecrest, Sweetwater, Miami Lakes, and the rest of Miami-Dade, plus Broward and Palm Beach counties. Elsewhere? See Houston, Dallas, or nationwide website maintenance. Florida property managers and HOAs: see HOA website maintenance in Florida.

What Maintenance Cannot Guarantee

  • No plan makes a site un-hackable; maintenance sharply reduces the risk and guarantees a clean, recent backup to restore from.
  • We cannot control hosting outages, domain expirations managed elsewhere, or third-party services (payment gateways, booking vendors) going down.
  • Rankings, AI citations, traffic, and leads depend on factors beyond site health. Maintenance protects eligibility; it does not promise positions.
  • Sites with abandoned, incompatible, or nulled plugins may need those parts rebuilt before they can be maintained safely; we say so up front.
  • Same-day repair is typical, not guaranteed; complex hacks and host-side problems can take longer, and we tell you when they will.
Example methodology, not a case study

How a Typical First Month Goes for a Doral Cleaning Company

Situation. A commercial cleaning company in Doral with a four-year-old bilingual WordPress site and an instant-quote form. The owner suspects leads have dropped but does not know why.

Health check finds. 19 pending plugin updates including an abandoned form plugin; PHP 7.4 on a host about to retire it; the quote form sending to a former employee’s address; Spanish pages missing hreflang; Google Business Profile listing the old warehouse address.

Week 1. Full backup, fix the form recipient and add logging, correct the Business Profile, update PHP on staging and confirm nothing breaks.

Weeks 2 to 3. Replace the abandoned form plugin, apply remaining updates on staging then live, add hreflang and LocalBusiness schema matching the site and Profile.

Week 4. First monthly report: form delivering, Spanish and English pages indexed correctly, Search Console clean, next steps listed. Then the cycle repeats. Outcomes vary by site; this describes the structure of the work, not a promised result.

Is Your Miami Website Secure, Fast, and Actually Sending You Leads?

We will check errors, security, speed, forms, and Google visibility for free and tell you what we find, whether or not you start a plan.

Request My Free Health Check

How much does website maintenance cost in Miami?

Plans start at $300 per month for Basic (updates, backups, security, monitoring, form and speed checks). Advanced runs $500 to $1,000 per month and adds Google Business Profile, SEO, and AI search readiness. Premium is $1,500 to $2,000 per month and adds full digital marketing. All plans are month to month.

What does a website maintenance plan include?

CMS, plugin, theme, and PHP updates; security monitoring and malware prevention; off-site backups with tested restores; uptime, error, and form monitoring; speed and Core Web Vitals checks; a technical SEO health check; and a monthly report. Higher plans add Business Profile, SEO, AI visibility, and marketing.

Do you maintain websites you did not build?

Yes. We regularly take over WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, and custom PHP sites built by other Miami agencies or freelancers. Onboarding includes documenting and stabilizing the site before monthly maintenance begins.

Do you have an office in Miami?

No. FixWebsiteIssues is based in Houston, Texas, and serves Miami-Dade remotely with secure, controlled access, which is how website maintenance is delivered everywhere. Miami clients call the same 24/7 number and get the same team.

How fast do you respond to an emergency?

Plan clients call 24/7. Most errors, such as white screens, broken pages, and plugin conflicts, are fixed the same day; hacks are contained within hours. Same-day is typical, not a guarantee.

Isn't website maintenance covered by my hosting?

Hosting keeps the server online. It does not update plugins, scan the site for malware, test forms, or watch Search Console. Most hacked sites we repair were on good hosting; the site itself was never maintained.

Can you maintain a bilingual English and Spanish site?

Yes. Many Miami client sites carry Spanish pages. We keep both language versions updated, check hreflang and indexing for each, and test forms in both languages. No extra charge when the Spanish pages already exist.

Does website maintenance help SEO?

Yes. Fixing errors, improving speed, keeping pages indexable, and maintaining accurate structured data are all factors Google documents. Advanced and Premium plans add on-page SEO and Google Business Profile work.

Does maintenance affect how AI tools like ChatGPT see my business?

AI assistants retrieve live web pages; a slow, blocked, or error-filled site is skipped. Every plan keeps the site crawlable and current; Advanced and Premium maintain schema, entity consistency, and crawler access for AI systems.

Which industries do you maintain websites for in Miami?

Small businesses, medical, dental, and aesthetic practices, home services and trades, restaurants and hospitality, ecommerce, law firms, real estate, and professional services. Each gets a checklist tuned to its integrations and pages.

How do I get started?

Request a free site health check. We review errors, security, speed, forms, and Google visibility and share findings. If you start a plan, onboarding takes a few days; the first monthly cycle begins as soon as the site is stable.
